VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: cows
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Descended from the great bovines of Old Earth, this family encompasses hardy grazing animals bred for meat, milk, labor, and other useful traits.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: pigs
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Versatile omnivores prized for their rapid growth and efficient conversion of food into meat, with numerous breeds adapted to different forms of husbandry.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: sheep
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Herding animals traditionally valued for their fiber and meat, selectively bred into breeds ranging from hardy pasture grazers to specialized producers.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: boomalope
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Strange, fire-prone livestock descended from engineered animals, selectively bred for their volatile biology and unusual adaptations.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: goats
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Hardy, domesticated mammals valued for their milk, their ability to digest tough foliage and a remarkable climbing ability.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: horses
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: A family of hardy, hoofed animals valued for their strength, speed, and endurance, serving as reliable mounts and beasts of burden.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: alpacas
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: A domesticated species of camelid with dense, luxurious wool and a surprisingly stubborn temperament.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: camels
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Hardy pack animals adapted to harsh, arid environments, capable of carrying heavy loads over long distances.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: cassowaries
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Large, flightless birds with powerful legs and a dangerous, dagger-like claw.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: chickens
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Common domesticated birds prized for their eggs, meat, and easygoing nature.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: ducks
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Domesticated waterfowl valued for their eggs, meat, and hardy nature.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: emus
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Large, flightless birds with long legs and a curious, adaptable nature.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: megachickens
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Unusual royal farm birds raised by spoiled royalty as a pet project. These birds simply never stop growing.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: ostriches
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Large, flightless birds prized for their speed, hardiness, and enormous eggs.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: peacocks
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Striking birds prized for their colorful plumage and magnificent tail feathers.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: quail
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Small, hardy birds valued for their eggs, meat, and prolific breeding.

VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.label: swan
VEF.AnimalGenes.FeratypeFamilyDef.description: Graceful waterfowl known for their striking plumage, long necks, and strong pair bonds.
